channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minnesota pauses licenses for new adult day care centers amid fraud concerns
item.description: State officials plan to stop new providers from enrolling in other “high-risk” programs as they increase focus on oversight.

item.title: Is part of St. Paul’s Grand Avenue really blighted?
item.description: A developer is seeking a nearly $3 million tax incentive for a redevelopment project. But critics say the area shouldn’t qualify for the incentive.

item.title: Fear rippling through Minneapolis immigrant communities
item.description: As the Department of Homeland Security steps up immigration enforcement in Minnesota, arrests and other confrontations have been popping up in more locations.

item.title: Takeaways: Vladimir Tarasenko scores twice as Wild win fifth in a row by blanking Capitals 5-0
item.description: Filip Gustavsson recorded his third shutout this season, and Kirill Kaprizov set a franchise record for power-play goals.

item.title: U of M donors chastise firings and upheaval in Medical School tussle
item.description: Charitable groups say they want Dr. Jakub Tolar to continue as Medical School dean. The U said it does not comment on personnel matters.

item.title: Kia, Hyundai agree to free anti-theft equipment in Minnesota settlement
item.description: After a surge in Twin Cities auto thefts, Attorney General Keith Ellison investigated whether the South Korean car companies violated state consumer protection laws.

item.title: Teen arrested as suspect in online threats that closed south metro schools
item.description: Apple Valley, Eagan, Eastview and Rosemount and Burnsville high schools, along with the School of Environmental Studies, had called off classes as a precaution.

item.title: Walz signs executive orders to limit gun violence after legislative talks stall
item.description: Walz had pushed an assault-style weapons ban after the shooting at Annunciation Catholic Church and School in August, but talks with legislators broke down.

item.title: Agreement will keep Fairview in UnitedHealthcare’s network for 2026
item.description: The insurer says it is working with the health system to finalize the deal, which Fairview says will ensure “full, uninterrupted” access for patients.

item.title: Minneapolis City Council amends budget to avoid Frey veto
item.description: Behind the scenes, Mayor Jacob Frey and the council have been negotiating for weeks over several sticking points.
